rows.brief_clause: Real reusable SwiftUI/Compose production component and shared APIs
rows.assessment: Both bridges match the public model/component signatures. They forward callbacks and own no local state/UI. Future build/deployment compatibility remains unexecuted.

rows.brief_clause: availableMB >= downloadSizeMB; insufficient storage blocks primary
rows.assessment: Correct for frozen selected input values. Equality boundary is not among the selected inputs.

rows.brief_clause: Insufficient storage has priority over metered network gate
verification_routes: existing status/enabled rules, no competing-gates state
rows.assessment: T2-R2: the only insufficient-storage inputs are unmetered.

rows.brief_clause: Whole MB values come from caller; do not measure disk
rows.assessment: Positive caller-value handling is supported; the no-disk-measurement constraint is unindexed (T2-R5).

rows.brief_clause: Wi-Fi only initially selected; metered connection then blocks download
rows.assessment: All three independent cases exercise this state.

rows.brief_clause: Choice toggles and emits onWifiOnlyChange(newValue) once
verification_routes: action 2 successful native activation; permitted receipt/selected
rows.assessment: The false transition is checked exactly. A reverse true transition is not selected; this remains a sampling limit.

rows.brief_clause: Disabling Wi-Fi only permits metered download when storage sufficient
verification_routes: permitted selected=false, enabled=true, Ready to download
rows.assessment: Input values and expected state independently recompute correctly.

rows.brief_clause: Allowed primary emits onDownload(current id,wifiOnly) once
verification_routes: requested event action_index=4; default successful method gate
rows.assessment: Exact current ID and mobile/false event are pinned. An eligible Wi-Fi-only/true request is not selected.

rows.brief_clause: After request show requested and disable both choice and primary
verification_routes: requested native label/enabled and requested fill
rows.assessment: No disabled tap is counted as business dispatch.

rows.brief_clause: Record request without fetching audio
rows.assessment: No independent no-I/O/source inspection obligation or route (T2-R5).

rows.brief_clause: Disclosure initially closed; opens all caller chapter heading/body pairs in order
verification_routes: permitted/requested exact section strings + expanded order
rows.assessment: Eight chapter pairs and all copy are source-backed. Closed heading absence is not explicit; see B12.

rows.brief_clause: Disclosure also closes heading/body pairs in same model; no caller callback
verification_routes: only opening tap at action 1; reset closure after replacement
rows.assessment: No disclosure quiet event, reverse close activation, or explicit closed-heading proposition (T2-R1).

rows.brief_clause: New tour ID resets choice=true, disclosure closed, requested=false
verification_routes: same mounted caller update action 6 then full sweep checkpoint 7
rows.assessment: Replacement is a fresh same-process fixture stimulus. Bridges contain no .id/key wrapper or replacement state logic.

rows.brief_clause: New title/language/MB values update without callbacks
verification_routes: replaced labels/gates + exact empty event interval for caller update action 6
rows.assessment: Every selected case independently matches BRIEF-derived expectations. The successful caller_fixture_update method is mandatory in frozen native_checks.

rows.brief_clause: Status precedence and primary iff formula
rows.assessment: Selected expectations are correct; the explicit competing-gates priority is not exercised (T2-R2).

rows.brief_clause: All exact subtitle/disclosure/primary/choice strings and selected semantics
rows.assessment: Exact accessible text is separate from visible wrapping.

rows.brief_clause: Public P1 ordinary and P2 narrow/large; same source/API
verification_routes: source-pinned scenarios, launch fixtures/bridge hashes, environment contracts
rows.assessment: P1/P2 are separate scenarios; actual frozen reconstruction succeeds on both platforms. iOS large/xxxLarge and Android 1.0/1.3 are explicitly handled by the host.

rows.brief_clause: Host horizontal 16 and top 24; component width=requested width-32
rows.assessment: Static host reconstruction confirms 368/248 offered component units for 400/280 requested widths; Android explicit Float32 encoding is preserved. No native measurement is claimed.

rows.brief_clause: Pale component canvas/white surface own their solid painted gutters
rows.assessment: The approved narrow strips fit the stated nominal gutters. They prove sampled rendered color, not exact padding allocation.

rows.brief_clause: Solid ink mark exact role; single vertical flow/order
rows.assessment: Noninteractive semantic containers can preserve children. There is no computed text-color assertion.

rows.brief_clause: Nominal internal gutters/gaps/status minimum and typography guidance
verification_routes: explicit empty route with unsupported computed SwiftUI/font-layout rationale
rows.assessment: Advisory disposition is honest. The separately stated status inset minimum is assessed separately in B23.

rows.brief_clause: Choice-to-primary real native edge gap 12 ±0.75; primary height 56 ±0.75
verification_routes: control/accessibility_box same-frame geometry with pt/dp source tolerance
rows.assessment: Both actual native Button controls can share a final bottom viewport. No cross-frame subtraction/layout-box inference is required.

rows.brief_clause: Status text at least 16 native units inside band; logical leading 4% empty
rows.assessment: The 16-unit minimum has no text-inset assertion/proposition; leading and physical-left differ in RTL (T2-R4).

rows.brief_clause: All text wraps without line limits
rows.assessment: Other text roles lack no-truncation coverage (T2-R3). Two narrow static references also overflow (T2-R6).

rows.brief_clause: Realistic long content; no artificial fixed-height blank rows
verification_routes: caller chapter copy fixed before implementation
rows.assessment: Realistic provided copy and illustrative size guidance are verified; artificial spacer prohibition has no independent route (T2-R5). Approximate 3–5 viewports is advisory.

rows.brief_clause: Native parent owns scrolling; component adds no nested scroller
verification_routes: frozen native parent has one intended scroller
rows.assessment: Parent ownership is statically confirmed. No component-source/nested-scroller obligation covers the future component (T2-R5).

rows.brief_clause: Exact opaque fill/canvas/surface/ink roles; separate pixel rules
rows.assessment: Palette anchors, ARGB units, minimum support/count and zero RGB-channel tolerance reconstruct. Status/primary fully visible; tall canvas/surface use visible fragments. Unused waiting palette role is not exercised.

rows.brief_clause: Title hierarchy, wrapping, overlap and clipping remain separate MUST visual propositions
verification_routes: independently source-backed Boolean questions + two judges
rows.assessment: Atomic aspects and provenance are valid. The scope omission for non-title/body wrapping remains B24.

rows.brief_clause: Full overlapping evidence and actual bottom reachability in every expanded state
rows.assessment: Plan does not replace full scans with target-only frames. max_steps=18 and realistic copy are proposed budgets, not runtime guarantees.

rows.brief_clause: Native selected/enabled/labels; successful callback method and original intervals
rows.assessment: xcui_tap / compose_onclick / caller_fixture_update defaults, same process/input/event binding and successful dispatch are enforced for the three declared events. Disclosure is absent (B12).

rows.brief_clause: API: disclosure remains enabled after request
rows.assessment: No disclosure enabled assertion or post-request disclosure activation (T2-R1).

rows.brief_clause: Outside scope navigation/lifecycle/real network/disk operations; no cross-platform pixel baseline
verification_routes: reference illustrations and explicit evidence limits
rows.assessment: No native/runtime product pass is claimed by this review. The no-fetch/no-disk implementation constraints still need the source-only routes in B04/B10.

scope: Independent semantic comparison, not the compiler's index self-audit. Partial/missing mandatory rows prevent approval.
